name: wp-scf-starter
description: WordPress theme + mu-plugin + SCF starter for AI-assisted corporate sites

scripts.gate:rules: npm run check:naming && npm run check:links && npm run check:rules
scripts.gate:0: npm run check:config && npm run gate:rules && npm run check:hardcode && npm run check:seeds && npm run lint:php
scripts.gate:1: npm run lint:prototype && npm run check:config
scripts.gate:2: npm run check:seeds && npm run check:naming
scripts.gate:3: npm run lint:php && npm run check:seed-idempotent
scripts.gate:4: npm run check:config && npm run check:hardcode && node tools/gate.mjs e2e 4
scripts.gate:5: npm run check:config && npm run check:hardcode && npm run lint:php && node tools/gate.mjs e2e 5
scripts.gate:6: npm run check:config && npm run check:seeds && npm run lint:php && node tools/gate.mjs e2e 6
scripts.gate:7: npm run gate:0 && npm run test:tools && node tools/gate.mjs e2e 7
